palette.rule: Worked out from every reading: safeDarkAccent is accent when its perceived brightness (.299 R, .587 G, .114 B) is at least .34 from Light, else Dark; safeLightAccent is accent when at least .34 from Dark, else Light. Readings bracket the number: .333 to .350. Each inverse is Light on a color at least .34 from Light, else Dark.

fromColor.rule: lightAccent is hue+d, 40%, 94%; darkAccent is hue+d, 40%, 15%. d: Monochrome 0, Complementary 180, Analogous I +45, Analogous II -45. Read with Accent selected.
